simple.prompt: Our technical support team ___ the critical database migration successfully.
simple.explanation: Subject 'Our technical support team' adalah collective noun tunggal (setara 'it'), sehingga rumus Present Perfect memakai 'has' + past participle (V3): 'has completed'.

simple.prompt: The developers ___ the new security patch to the production server yet.
simple.explanation: 'The developers' (jamak/they) memakai 'haven't' + V3 'deployed'. Kata keterangan 'yet' digunakan di akhir kalimat negatif atau tanya.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect dengan kata keterangan 'already'.
simple.targetSentence: We have already submitted the project proposal.
simple.explanation: Pola: Subject (We) + have + already + V3 (submitted) + the project proposal.

simple.prompt: Have you ___ visited our regional branch office in Singapore?
simple.explanation: Dalam pertanyaan pengalaman hidup (life experience), gunakan 'ever' (pernah): 'Have you ever visited...?'

simple.targetSentence: She has never tasted authentic Italian pizza.
simple.explanation: Subject (She) + has + never + V3 (tasted) + authentic Italian pizza.

simple.prompt: I have ___ finished reading your draft; I put it on your desk five seconds ago.
simple.explanation: 'Just' digunakan untuk aksi yang baru saja selesai terjadi beberapa saat yang lalu: 'have just finished'.
hints: Baru saja selesai beberapa detik lalu.
Gunakan 'just' di antara have dan V3.

simple.targetSentence: Have they signed the partnership agreement?
simple.explanation: Auxiliary (Have) + Subject (they) + V3 (signed) + the partnership agreement?

simple.prompt: We ___ already signed the digital lease agreement.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'We' pada Present Perfect menggunakan auxiliary 'have' + V3 ('signed').

simple.prompt: Has the new intern ___ his orientation checklist yet?
simple.explanation: Rumus Present Perfect selalu membutuhkan Past Participle (V3): 'Has + S + V3' → 'finished'.
hints: Setelah 'Has', kata kerja harus berbentuk V3.

simple.prompt: I haven't received the parcel tracking number ___.
simple.explanation: Dalam kalimat negatif dan tanya Present Perfect, kata 'yet' diletakkan di akhir kalimat ('belum...').
hints: Kalimat berbentuk negatif ('haven't') dengan rumpang di ujung.
Penanda 'belum' di akhir kalimat negatif memakai 'yet'.

simple.prompt: Have you ___ visited the architectural museum in Rotterdam?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan pengalaman hidup ('Pernahkah Anda...?') menggunakan 'ever' setelah subjek.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan kantor dengan 'just' untuk kejadian baru saja terjadi.
dialogue: Should I email the supplier about the invoice?
No need — I have ___ spoken with their finance lead a minute ago.
simple.explanation: Peristiwa yang baru saja selesai beberapa saat lalu diungkapkan dengan 'have/has just + V3'.
hints: Perhatikan keterangan 'a minute ago' dalam konteks baru saja selesai.
Kata 'baru saja' di antara 'have' dan V3 adalah 'just'.

simple.prompt: Mr. Hadi has worked for this logistics firm ___ 2018.
simple.explanation: '2018' adalah titik awal dimulainya waktu (starting point), sehingga wajib memakai preposisi 'since'.
hints: '2018' bukan durasi panjang waktu, melainkan tahun mulai.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan pemakaian V2 instead of V3 pada kalimat Present Perfect berikut.
simple.draft: My sister has wrote three concise guides on urban gardening.
options: My sister has written three concise guides on urban gardening.
My sister have written three concise guides on urban gardening.
My sister has writing three concise guides on urban gardening.
simple.explanation: Bentuk Past Participle (V3) dari 'write' adalah 'written' (bukan 'wrote' yang merupakan V2).

simple.prompt: They have lived in that coastal neighborhood ___ eight years.
simple.explanation: 'Eight years' adalah total durasi/lama waktu, sehingga memakai 'for'.

simple.targetSentence: She has never missed a weekly mentorship session.
simple.explanation: 'Never' diletakkan antara 'has' dan V3 'missed' untuk menyatakan tidak pernah.

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Present Perfect dengan 'yet' di akhir.
simple.targetSentence: Have the auditors checked the December ledger yet?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Present Perfect membalik 'Have' ke depan subjek + V3 + ... + yet?
hints: Mulai pertanyaan dengan 'Have the auditors checked'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di resepsionis tentang kedatangan tamu.
dialogue: Has the overseas delegation arrived at the conference hall?
Yes, they have ___ arrived and are registering at the front desk.
intermediate.explanation: 'Just' menandakan peristiwa yang baru saja terjadi beberapa saat lalu: 'have just arrived'.
hints: Baru saja tiba dan sekarang sedang registrasi.

intermediate.prompt: She has worked as the chief financial officer ___ more than eight years.
intermediate.explanation: 'For' digunakan untuk menyatakan durasi atau rentang waktu terukur ('for eight years'). Sebaliknya 'since' untuk titik awal waktu ('since 2018').

intermediate.prompt: The engineering team has occupied this research facility ___ 2021.
intermediate.explanation: 'Since' digunakan untuk menyatakan titik awal dimulainya suatu keadaan yang berlanjut hingga sekarang: 'since 2021'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Perfect dengan 'since' dan klausa lampau.
intermediate.targetSentence: He has lived in Jakarta since he graduated from university.
intermediate.explanation: Present Perfect main clause (He has lived in Jakarta) + since + Past Simple clause (he graduated from university).
hints: Mulai dengan 'He has lived in Jakarta since'.
Klausa setelah since memakai Past Simple 'he graduated from university'.

intermediate.prompt: Perhatikan perbedaan arti: 'Sarah has ___ to London; she will return next week.'
intermediate.explanation: 'Has gone to' berarti pergi ke sana dan saat ini masih berada di sana (belum kembali). 'Has been to' berarti pernah berkunjung dan sekarang sudah pulang/kembali.
hints: Sarah saat ini masih di London (baru pulang minggu depan).

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat kunjungan pengalaman dengan 'have been to'.
intermediate.targetSentence: I have been to Japan twice.
intermediate.explanation: Subject (I) + have been to (pernah berkunjung bolak-balik) + Japan + frequency (twice).

intermediate.prompt: Pilih jawaban singkat yang tepat untuk pertanyaan Present Perfect.
dialogue: Have you reviewed the revised confidentiality clause?
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat positif Present Perfect: 'Yes, I have.'
hints: Cukup akhiri dengan auxiliary: 'Yes, I have.'

intermediate.prompt: Where is Maya? — She isn't at her desk; she has ___ to the print shop and will return at two.
intermediate.explanation: 'Has gone to' berarti seseorang pergi ke suatu tempat dan SAAT INI masih di sana/belum kembali ('isn't at her desk').
hints: Maya saat ini belum kembali ke mejanya.
Masih berada di tujuan/dalam perjalanan memakai 'gone'.

intermediate.prompt: Welcome back, Dani! You look tanned — have you ___ to Lombok?
intermediate.explanation: 'Have been to' berarti pernah berkunjung ke suatu tempat dan SUDAH KEMBALI lagi.
hints: Dani sudah kembali dan sedang diajak bicara sekarang.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan yang membedakan Present Perfect dan Past Simple.
dialogue: Has Rina sent the revised presentation slides?
Yes, she ___ them to your inbox ten minutes ago.
intermediate.explanation: Karena ada penanda waktu lampau spesifik yang sudah selesai ('ten minutes ago'), kalimat kedua wajib beralih ke Past Simple ('emailed'), bukan Present Perfect.
hints: Perhatikan frasa 'ten minutes ago' di ujung kalimat.
Waktu spesifik lampau (...ago) tidak boleh memakai Present Perfect.

intermediate.prompt: This is the first time our regional team ___ a solar-powered water pump.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah ungkapan 'This is the first/second time...', pola standar memakai Present Perfect ('has installed').
hints: Pola tetap: 'This is the first time + S + has/have + V3'.
Subjek tunggal 'our regional team' memakai 'has installed'.

intermediate.prompt: How long ___ you known your co-founder?
intermediate.explanation: Menanyakan durasi keadaan yang dimulai di masa lalu hingga kini ('How long...?') dengan stative verb 'know' memakai Present Perfect: 'How long have you known...'.
hints: 'Know' adalah stative verb untuk durasi hingga sekarang.

intermediate.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum menggabungkan 'since' dengan waktu lampau yang selesai dengan Past Simple.
intermediate.draft: I live in Bandung since I graduated from college five years ago.
options: I have lived in Bandung since I graduated from college five years ago.
I am living in Bandung since I graduated from college five years ago.
I have live in Bandung since I graduated from college five years ago.
intermediate.explanation: Tindakan atau tempat tinggal yang berawal di masa lalu ('since I graduated') dan masih berlanjut sampai sekarang wajib memakai Present Perfect ('have lived'), bukan Present Simple.
hints: Ada klausa 'since I graduated' yang masih berlanjut hingga kini.

intermediate.prompt: Have your cousins confirmed their flight seats? — No, they ___.
intermediate.explanation: Jawaban singkat negatif dari pertanyaan 'Have your cousins...?' memakai auxiliary 'haven't'.

intermediate.prompt: That documentary is the most insightful film I ___ this year.
intermediate.explanation: Setelah pola superlative pengalaman ('the most [adj] + noun + that I...'), gunakan Present Perfect ('have watched').
hints: Lihat superlative 'the most insightful film' + 'this year'.
Klausa superlative pengalaman memakai Present Perfect.

intermediate.targetSentence: This is the clearest tutorial I have ever read.
intermediate.explanation: Pola 'the + superlative + noun + I have ever + V3' adalah konstruksi idiomatik baku.
hints: Awali dengan 'This is the clearest tutorial'.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan 'since' diikuti klausa Past Simple.
intermediate.targetSentence: Our startup has grown rapidly since we launched the mobile platform.
intermediate.explanation: Klausa utama memakai Present Perfect ('has grown'), sedangkan klausa setelah 'since' memakai Past Simple ('launched').
hints: Mulai dengan 'Our startup has grown rapidly'.
Sambungkan 'since we launched the mobile platform'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan fatal mencampur penanda waktu lampau spesifik dengan Present Perfect.
complex.draft: Our marketing division has launched the regional advertising campaign yesterday.
options: Our marketing division launched the regional advertising campaign yesterday.
Our marketing division has launched the regional advertising campaign since yesterday.
Our marketing division was launched the regional advertising campaign yesterday.
complex.explanation: Penanda waktu lampau yang sudah selesai dan spesifik (definite finished past time seperti 'yesterday', 'last night', 'in 2010', 'three days ago') DILARANG menggunakan Present Perfect. Wajib menggunakan Past Simple: 'launched... yesterday'.
hints: 'Yesterday' adalah waktu lampau selesai dan spesifik.
Gunakan Past Simple V2 'launched', bukan 'has launched'.

complex.prompt: Pola penomoran pengalaman hidup: 'This is the first time our company ___ an international design award.'
complex.explanation: Setelah formula 'This is the first/second time...', bahasa Inggris baku selalu menggunakan Present Perfect: 'has won'.
hints: Pola: 'This is the first time + Present Perfect'.

complex.prompt: This is the most challenging architectural project that we ___ on.
complex.explanation: Setelah konstruksi superlative ('the most challenging project'), klausa penjelas pengalaman hidup menggunakan Present Perfect: 'that we have ever worked on'.

complex.targetSentence: That was the best meal I have ever eaten.
complex.explanation: Superlative (the best meal) + that I have ever eaten (Present Perfect).
hints: Mulai dengan 'That was the best meal'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan antara 'for' dan 'since' dengan kata penunjuk durasi 'last'.
complex.draft: We haven't received any shipment updates since three weeks.
options: We haven't received any shipment updates for three weeks.
We haven't received any shipment updates since for three weeks.
We haven't received any shipment updates during three weeks.
complex.explanation: 'Three weeks' adalah besaran durasi panjang waktu, sehingga preposisi yang benar adalah 'for three weeks', bukan 'since'.
hints: Tiga minggu adalah rentang durasi terukur.

complex.prompt: Notice the difference with 'the last': '___ the last three weeks, our sales have increased.'
complex.explanation: Frasa 'for the last/past three weeks' menyatakan durasi kurun waktu yang membentang hingga hari ini, sehingga memakai 'for'. ('Since last week' menyatakan titik awal).
hints: 'The last three weeks' adalah rentang durasi 21 hari terakhir.

dialogue: How long ___ as a certified cloud architect?
I have worked in cloud architecture for almost seven years.
complex.explanation: Pertanyaan durasi keadaan yang masih berlangsung hingga saat ini menggunakan 'How long have you worked...?'
hints: Menanyakan durasi pekerjaan yang masih berlanjut sampai sekarang.

complex.prompt: Look closely at the ongoing period: 'He ___ three client calls so far today, and the afternoon has barely begun.'
complex.explanation: Karena 'today' belum berakhir dan frasa 'so far' menandai rentang waktu dari pagi sampai detik ini, gunakan Present Perfect ('has handled').
hints: Frasa 'so far today' menunjukkan periode yang masih terbuka hingga kini.

complex.prompt: Contrast that with a finished morning period: 'He ___ three client calls before lunch, and now it is 4 p.m.'
complex.explanation: Pada pukul 4 sore, waktu 'before lunch' sudah sepenuhnya selesai dan tertutup, sehingga wajib menggunakan Past Simple ('handled').
hints: Sekarang jam 4 sore, jadi 'before lunch' adalah masa lalu yang selesai.
Waktu lampau tertutup memakai Past Simple.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan bentuk tense pada klausa 'since' yang sering terbalik berikut.
complex.draft: Since the new software has been deployed last April, ticket errors dropped by forty percent.
options: Since the new software was deployed last April, ticket errors have dropped by forty percent.
Since the new software deployed last April, ticket errors dropped by forty percent.
Since the new software has been deployed last April, ticket errors are dropping by forty percent.
complex.explanation: Kejadian titik awal yang sudah usai ('last April') di dalam klausa 'Since...' memakai Past Simple ('was deployed'), sedangkan hasil kumulatif hingga kini di klausa utama memakai Present Perfect ('have dropped').
hints: Setelah 'since' dengan penanda waktu selesai 'last April', pakai Past Simple.
Dampaknya dari April hingga sekarang memakai Present Perfect.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan akademik tentang fakta penulis yang masih aktif berkarya vs tokoh historis.
dialogue: Which tense is right: 'Shakespeare wrote 37 plays' or 'Shakespeare has written 37 plays'?
Because Shakespeare's lifetime is completely finished, we must say ___.
complex.explanation: Untuk karya tokoh yang sudah wafat (rentang hidup/periode pencapaian tertutup), gunakan Past Simple ('wrote'), bukan Present Perfect.
hints: Periode hidup Shakespeare sudah tutup sepenuhnya di masa lalu.
Gunakan Past Simple untuk tokoh sejarah.

complex.prompt: Up to the present moment, no external researcher ___ able to replicate that anomaly.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'Up to the present moment' menandakan periode terbuka hingga kini; subjek negatif 'no external researcher' tunggal memakai 'has been'.
hints: Rentang waktu 'up to the present moment' berpasangan dengan Present Perfect.

complex.prompt: It ___ two years since our coastal clinic last recorded a major power outage.
complex.explanation: Pola idiomatik jarak waktu hingga kini: 'It has been [duration] since + Subject + Past Simple'.
hints: Struktur waktu sejak kejadian terakhir: 'It has been + durasi + since...'.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan umum penulisan surat resmi terkait pemakaian 'yet' di kalimat positif.
complex.draft: We have yet received confirmation from the customs office regarding your shipment.
options: We have not yet received confirmation from the customs office regarding your shipment.
We didn't yet received confirmation from the customs office regarding your shipment.
We haven't still received confirmation from the customs office regarding your shipment.
complex.explanation: Untuk bermakna 'belum' bersama 'received', bentuk negatif wajib memakai 'not' ('have not yet received' atau 'haven't received ... yet').
hints: 'Have yet received' dalam ragam standar kurang 'not' untuk makna 'belum'.

complex.prompt: In business reporting, 'Sales ___ steadily over the past three quarters' shows continuing relevance right into this week.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'over the past three quarters' (kurun waktu yang berakhir tepat di saat ini) menggunakan Present Perfect ('have climbed').
hints: 'Over the past...' menghubungkan masa lalu langsung ke masa kini.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pembuka formal tentang perubahan bertahap hingga saat ini.
complex.targetSentence: Several coastal cities have already adopted stricter flood barrier standards.
complex.explanation: 'Already' diletakkan setelah 'have' dan sebelum V3 'adopted' untuk penekanan hasil.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Several coastal cities have already'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat pengalaman dengan 'for' yang merujuk pada proyek masih berjalan.
complex.targetSentence: Our R&D unit has collaborated with local farmers for nearly a decade.
complex.explanation: 'For nearly a decade' menggambarkan kolaborasi yang masih terus berlanjut hingga kini.
hints: Awali dengan 'Our R&D unit has collaborated'.
Tambahkan 'with local farmers for nearly a decade'.
